scope: Read-only review of the frozen trajectory exposition changes; no edits, builds or expanded checks.
checks: Prefix laws are explicitly joint laws of the partial trajectories; their layer-zero laws are the full trajectory laws.
The m marginals are correctly described as state visitation probabilities, with terminal probabilities and cemetery absorption distinguished.

BC^(l) and H^(l) use the existing normalized definitions, and the full target H(Pi_A,Pi_B)=H^(0)=sqrt(1-BC^(0)) is explicit. Squared superscript notation is valid and monotonicity retains its decreasing-layer direction.
The g quantity is explicitly overlap of prefix path probabilities. It is not identified with the geometric mean of endpoint marginals; the retained strict comparison explains their distinction.
Moving the terminal sum-of-squares to the definition preserves the quantity exactly. Expansion yields the same labeled closed form, nonnegativity and total, with the cemetery included.
The unchanged ordinary-state subtotal is unnormalized; the distinct conditional-survival normalization remains intact.
Path measure, marginal recurrences, geometric kernel, chain rule and overlap recursion are byte-identical. The labeled terminal display differs only by replacing its defining coloneqq with equality.
The complete conditioned-survival subsection, labels, aliases and Lean badges are unchanged.

ptnb:eq:conditioned-bc-kernel.reason: The unchanged generic prefix product still specializes to the conditioned kernels in the unchanged conditioned-survival theorem, with positive survival and denominator conditions retained.

ptnb:eq:conditioned-per-pixel-h2.reason: The terminal contribution has the same squared path-measure definition and identical computed formula. Applying it to normalized conditioned laws therefore gives exactly the same conditioned map.
